title.ur: Insaan ko tafreeh ki zaroorat hoti hai

intro.en: Nora visits her friend Layla in hospital. The doctor told Layla to change her lifestyle because her whole life is work. Listen for how they talk about the problem and the good advice.
intro.ur: Noura apni saheli Layla se hospital mein milne aati hai. Doctor ne Layla se kaha ke apna tarz-e-zindagi badle kyunke uski poori zindagi kaam hi kaam hai. Dhyan se sunein ke woh masle aur achhe mashware ke baare mein kaise baat karti hain.
intro.ar: تَزورُ نورَةُ صَديقَتَها لَيْلى في المُسْتَشْفى، فَقَدْ طَلَبَ مِنْها الطَّبيبُ أَنْ تُغَيِّرَ أُسْلوبَ حَياتِها لِأَنَّ حَياتَها كُلَّها عَمَلٌ. اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى كَيْفِيَّةِ حَديثِهِما عَنِ المُشْكِلَةِ وَالنَّصيحَةِ.

dialogue.ar: سَلامَتُكِ يا لَيْلى! عَلِمْتُ بِالخَبَرِ فَجِئْتُ مُسْرِعَةً.
dialogue.tr: salāmatuki yā laylā! ʿalimtu bil-khabari faji'tu musriʿatan.
dialogue.en: Get well, Layla! I heard the news and came quickly.
dialogue.ur: Layla, aap jaldi theek ho jayein! Khabar mili to main foran aa gayi.

dialogue.ar: أَهْلاً يا نورَةُ، شُكْراً عَلى زِيارَتِكِ. أَنا بِخَيْرٍ الآنَ.
dialogue.tr: ahlan yā nūratu, shukran ʿalā zīratiki. anā bikhayrin al-'āna.
dialogue.en: Welcome, Nora, thank you for visiting. I am fine now.
dialogue.ur: Khush aamdeed Noura, aane ka shukriya. Ab main theek hoon.

dialogue.ar: ماذا حَصَلَ لَكِ؟ كُنْتِ تَضْحَكينَ مَعَنا أَمْسِ!
dialogue.tr: mādhā ḥaṣala laki? kunti taḍḥakīna maʿanā amsi!
dialogue.en: What happened to you? You were laughing with us yesterday!
dialogue.ur: Aapko kya hua? Kal to aap hamare saath hans rahi thin!

dialogue.ar: كُنْتُ في الشَّرِكَةِ أَكْتُبُ تَقْريراً، ثُمَّ أُغْمِيَ عَلَيَّ فَجْأَةً.
dialogue.tr: kuntu fī sh-sharikati aktubu taqrīran, thumma ughmiya ʿalayya faj'atan.
dialogue.en: I was in the company writing a report, then I suddenly fainted.
dialogue.ur: Main company mein report likh rahi thi, phir achanak mujh par behoshi taari ho gayi.

dialogue.ar: وَحينَ أَفَقْتُ وَجَدْتُ المُمَرِّضَةَ بِجانِبي في المُسْتَشْفى.
dialogue.tr: waḥīna afaqtu wajadtu l-mumarriḍata bijānibī fī l-mustashfā.
dialogue.en: And when I woke up I found the nurse beside me in the hospital.
dialogue.ur: Aur jab mujhe hosh aaya to maine nurse ko apne paas hospital mein paaya.

dialogue.ar: وَماذا قالَ الطَّبيبُ؟
dialogue.tr: wamādhā qāla ṭ-ṭabību?
dialogue.en: And what did the doctor say?
dialogue.ur: Aur doctor ne kya kaha?

dialogue.ar: فَحَصَني، وَقالَ إِنَّ جِسْمي سَليمٌ.
dialogue.tr: faḥaṣanī, waqāla inna jismī salīmun.
dialogue.en: He examined me and said my body is healthy.
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne mera muayna kiya aur kaha ke mera jism theek hai.

dialogue.ar: الحَمْدُ للهِ! إِذَنْ ما المُشْكِلَةُ؟
dialogue.tr: al-ḥamdu llhi! idhan mā l-mushkilatu?
dialogue.en: Praise be to Allah! So what is the problem?
dialogue.ur: Alhamdulillah! To phir masla kya hai?

dialogue.ar: المُشْكِلَةُ في أُسْلوبِ حَياتي، فَقَدْ طَلَبَ مِنّي أَنْ أُغَيِّرَهُ.
dialogue.tr: al-mushkilatu fī uslūbi ḥaytī, faqad ṭalaba minnī an ughayyirahu.
dialogue.en: The problem is in my lifestyle; he asked me to change it.
dialogue.ur: Masla mere tarz-e-zindagi mein hai, unhon ne kaha ke ise badlun.

dialogue.ar: أُسْلوبُ حَياتِكِ؟ أَمْرٌ عَجيبٌ حَقّاً! وَما مَعْنى كَلامِهِ؟
dialogue.tr: uslūbu ḥaytiki? amrun ʿajībun ḥaqqan! wamā maʿnā kalāmihi?
dialogue.en: Your lifestyle? How strange indeed! And what does he mean?
dialogue.ur: Aapka tarz-e-zindagi? Waqai ajeeb baat hai! Unka matlab kya hai?

dialogue.ar: يَعْني أَنَّني أَعْمَلُ مِنَ الصَّباحِ إِلَى اللَّيْلِ، وَلا أَجِدُ وَقْتاً لِلتَّرْوِيحِ.
dialogue.tr: yaʿnī annanī aʿmalu mina ṣ-ṣabāḥi ilā l-layli, walā ajidu waqtan lilttarwīḥi.
dialogue.en: It means I work from morning to night and find no time for recreation.
dialogue.ur: Matlab yeh ke main subah se raat tak kaam karti hoon aur tafreeh ke liye waqt nahi milta.

dialogue.ar: لَقَدْ صَدَقَ الطَّبيبُ، فَأَنْتِ تَعْمَلينَ دائِماً!
dialogue.tr: laqad ṣadaqa ṭ-ṭabību, fa'anti taʿmalīna dā'iman!
dialogue.en: The doctor was right, you are always working!
dialogue.ur: Doctor ne sach kaha, aap to hamesha kaam karti rehti hain!

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ، وَنَصَحَني أَنْ أَقْضِيَ أُسْبوعاً في بَلَدٍ هادِئٍ جَميلٍ.
dialogue.tr: naʿam, wanaṣaḥanī an aqḍiya usbūʿan fī baladin hādi'in jamīlin.
dialogue.en: Yes, and he advised me to spend a week in a calm, beautiful country.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, aur unhon ne mashwara diya ke main ek hafta kisi pur-sukoon khoobsurat mulk mein guzaarun.

dialogue.ar: هَذِهِ نَصيحَةٌ ذَهَبِيَّةٌ، فَاسْمَعي كَلامَ الطَّبيبِ.
dialogue.tr: hādhihi naṣīḥatun dhahabiyyatun, fāsmaʿī kalāma ṭ-ṭabībi.
dialogue.en: This is golden advice, so listen to the doctor.
dialogue.ur: Yeh sunehri naseehat hai, doctor ki baat maan lijiye.

dialogue.ar: سَأَفْعَلُ ذَلِكَ، وَسَأُغَيِّرُ أُسْلوبَ حَياتي.
dialogue.tr: sa'afʿalu dhālika, wasa'ughayyiru uslūba ḥaytī.
dialogue.en: I will do that, and I will change my lifestyle.
dialogue.ur: Main aisa hi karungi aur apna tarz-e-zindagi badlungi.

q.en: Where did Layla find the nurse when she woke up?
q.ur: Layla ne hosh aane par nurse ko kahan paaya?
q.ar: أَيْنَ وَجَدَتْ لَيْلى المُمَرِّضَةَ حينَ أَفاقَتْ؟

q.en: What did the doctor ask Layla to change?
q.ur: Doctor ne Layla se kya badalne ko kaha?
q.ar: ماذا طَلَبَ الطَّبيبُ مِنْ لَيْلى أَنْ تُغَيِّرَ؟

q.en: What does «العُطْلَة» mean?
q.ur: «العُطْلَة» ka matlab kya hai?

options_ar: أَيّامُ راحَةٍ مِنَ العَمَلِ أَوِ الدِّراسَةِ

q.en: What was the doctor's advice?
q.ur: Doctor ka mashwara kya tha?

options: أَنْ تَقْضِيَ أُسْبوعاً في بَلَدٍ جَميلٍ

q.en: Which word means "he examined"?
q.ur: "Usne mu'ayena kiya" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني: كَشَفَ الطَّبيبُ عَلى المَريضِ؟

title.en: Sounds: hamza أ and madda آ

intro.en: A hamza followed by an alif is called a madda (آ). The sound is stretched long, unlike a single hamza (أ). Listen and compare the pairs.
intro.ur: Hamza ke baad alif aaye to usay madda (آ) kehte hain; is ki awaaz lambi kheenchi jati hai, jabke akeli hamza (أ) chhoti hoti hai. Sun kar dono ka farq dekhein.
intro.ar: إِذا جاءَتْ بَعْدَ الهَمْزَةِ أَلِفٌ سُمِّيَتْ مَدَّةً (آ)، وَيَكونُ الصَّوْتُ طَويلاً بِخِلافِ الهَمْزَةِ وَحْدَها (أ). اِسْتَمِعْ وَقارِنْ بَيْنَ الأَزْواجِ.

q.en: What is the letter آ called?
q.ur: Harf آ ko kya kehte hain?

q.en: Which word has a long آ sound?
q.ur: Kis lafz mein lambi آ ki awaaz hai?

q.en: What does «آسِف» mean?
q.ur: «آسِف» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Which word means "he ate"?
q.ur: "Usne khaya" kaun sa lafz hai?

intro.en: Arabic has special words for asking questions: مَنْ (who), ما (what), ماذا (what), لِماذا (why), كَيْفَ (how), مَتى (when), أَيْنَ (where), كَمْ (how many), أَيّ (which), هَلْ and أ (yes/no questions). Example: «كَيْفَ حالُكَ؟» How are you?
intro.ur: Arabi mein sawaal poochne ke khaas alfaaz hain: مَنْ (kaun), ما (kya), ماذا (kya), لِماذا (kyun), كَيْفَ (kaise), مَتى (kab), أَيْنَ (kahan), كَمْ (kitne), أَيّ (kaun sa), aur هَلْ / أ (haan ya na wale sawaal). Misaal: «كَيْفَ حالُكَ؟» Aap kaise hain?
intro.ar: لِلْعَرَبِيَّةِ أَدَواتٌ خاصَّةٌ لِلسُّؤالِ: مَنْ، ما، ماذا، لِماذا، كَيْفَ، مَتى، أَيْنَ، كَمْ، أَيّ، وَهَلْ وَالهَمْزَةُ لِلسُّؤالِ الَّذي جَوابُهُ نَعَمْ أَوْ لا. مِثالٌ: «كَيْفَ حالُكَ؟»

dialogue.ar: مَنْ هَذِهِ؟ هَذِهِ أُخْتي.
dialogue.tr: man hādhihi? hādhihi ukhtī.
dialogue.en: Who is this? This is my sister.
dialogue.ur: Yeh kaun hai? Yeh meri behen hai.

dialogue.ar: ما هَذا؟ هَذا قَلَمٌ جَديدٌ.
dialogue.tr: mā hādhā? hādhā qalamun jadīdun.
dialogue.en: What is this? This is a new pen.
dialogue.ur: Yeh kya hai? Yeh naya qalam hai.

dialogue.ar: ماذا تَشْرَبُ؟ أَشْرَبُ عَصيراً بارِداً.
dialogue.tr: mādhā tashrabu? ashrabu ʿaṣīran bāridan.
dialogue.en: What are you drinking? I am drinking cold juice.
dialogue.ur: Aap kya pi rahe hain? Main thanda juice pi raha hoon.

dialogue.ar: لِماذا تَبْكي؟ لِأَنَّني أَضَعْتُ لُعْبَتي.
dialogue.tr: limādhā tabkī? li'annanī aḍaʿtu luʿbatī.
dialogue.en: Why are you crying? Because I lost my toy.
dialogue.ur: Aap kyun ro rahe hain? Kyunke meri khilona kho gaya.

dialogue.ar: كَيْفَ أُمُّكَ؟ هِيَ بِخَيْرٍ، شُكْراً لَكَ.
dialogue.tr: kayfa ummuka? hiya bikhayrin, shukran laka.
dialogue.en: How is your mother? She is well, thank you.
dialogue.ur: Aapki ammi kaisi hain? Woh theek hain, shukriya.

dialogue.ar: مَتى يَصِلُ أَبوكَ؟ يَصِلُ غَداً، إِنْ شاءَ اللهُ.
dialogue.tr: matā yaṣilu abūka? yaṣilu ghadan, in shā'a llāh.
dialogue.en: When does your father arrive? He arrives tomorrow, God willing.
dialogue.ur: Aapke abbu kab pohanchte hain? Kal pohanchenge, inshaAllah.

dialogue.ar: أَيْنَ مِفْتاحي؟ هُوَ عَلَى الطّاوِلَةِ.
dialogue.tr: ayna miftāḥī? huwa ʿalā ṭ-ṭāwilati.
dialogue.en: Where is my key? It is on the table.
dialogue.ur: Meri chaabi kahan hai? Woh mez par hai.

dialogue.ar: كَمْ كِتاباً عِنْدَكَ؟ عِنْدي سَبْعَةُ كُتُبٍ.
dialogue.tr: kam kitāban ʿindaka? ʿindī sabʿatu kutubin.
dialogue.en: How many books do you have? I have seven books.
dialogue.ur: Aapke paas kitni kitaabein hain? Mere paas saat kitaabein hain.

dialogue.ar: أَيُّ لَوْنٍ تُحِبُّ؟ أُحِبُّ اللَّوْنَ الأَخْضَرَ.
dialogue.tr: ayyu lawnin tuḥibbu? uḥibbu l-lawna l-'akhḍara.
dialogue.en: Which colour do you like? I like the colour green.
dialogue.ur: Aapko kaun sa rang pasand hai? Mujhe hara rang pasand hai.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ حانَ وَقْتُ الأَذانِ؟ نَعَمْ، بَعْدَ دَقيقَتَيْنِ.
dialogue.tr: hal ḥāna waqtu l-'adhāni? naʿam, baʿda daqīqatayni.
dialogue.en: Is it time for the adhan? Yes, in two minutes.
dialogue.ur: Kya azaan ka waqt ho gaya? Ji haan, do minute baad.

q.en: Which word asks "where"?
q.ur: "Kahan" poochne ka lafz kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ أَداةٍ يُسْأَلُ بِها عَنِ المَكانِ؟

q.en: Which word asks "when"?
q.ur: "Kab" poochne ka lafz kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ أَداةٍ يُسْأَلُ بِها عَنِ الزَّمانِ؟

q.en: Which question word asks about a number (how many)?
q.ur: Tadaad poochne (kitne) ka lafz kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ أَداةٍ يُسْأَلُ بِها عَنِ العَدَدِ؟

q.en: Which question word asks "who"?
q.ur: "Kaun" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ أَداةٍ يُسْأَلُ بِها عَنِ الشَّخْصِ العاقِلِ؟

q.en: Which word starts a yes/no question like «..... حانَ وَقْتُ الأَذانِ؟»
q.ur: «..... حانَ وَقْتُ الأَذانِ؟» jaise haan/na wale sawal ko kaunsa lafz shuru karta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ أَداةٍ تُبْدَأُ بِها جُمْلَةُ «..... حانَ وَقْتُ الأَذانِ؟» لِسُؤالٍ جَوابُهُ نَعَمْ أَوْ لا؟

title.en: Listening and speaking: daily life and holidays
title.ur: Sunna aur bolna: rozmarra aur chhuttiyan

intro.en: Practice asking a partner about work, study and holidays. Use the question words you learned: كَمْ (how many), مَتى (when), ماذا (what), كَيْفَ (how).
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein apne saathi se kaam, parhai aur chhuttiyon ke baare mein sawaal poochne ki mashq karein. Jo sawaal ke alfaaz seekhe hain unhein istemal karein: كَمْ، مَتى، ماذا، كَيْفَ.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى أَنْ تَسْأَلَ زَميلَكَ عَنِ العَمَلِ وَالدِّراسَةِ وَالعُطْلَةِ، مُسْتَعْمِلاً أَدَواتِ الاسْتِفْهامِ: كَمْ، مَتى، ماذا، كَيْفَ.

dialogue.ar: كَمْ ساعَةً تَعْمَلُ أَوْ تَدْرُسُ كُلَّ صَباحٍ؟
dialogue.tr: kam sāʿatan taʿmalu aw tadrusu kulla ṣabāḥin?
dialogue.en: How many hours do you work or study every morning?
dialogue.ur: Aap har subah kitne ghante kaam ya parhai karte hain?

dialogue.ar: كَمْ يَوْماً في الأُسْبوعِ تَذْهَبُ إِلَى العَمَلِ؟
dialogue.tr: kam yawman fī l-'usbūʿi tadhhabu ilā l-ʿamali?
dialogue.en: How many days a week do you go to work?
dialogue.ur: Aap hafte mein kitne din kaam par jaate hain?

dialogue.ar: مَتى تَبْدَأُ عُطْلَتُكَ في نِهايَةِ الأُسْبوعِ؟
dialogue.tr: matā tabda'u ʿuṭlatuka fī nihāyati l-'usbūʿi?
dialogue.en: When does your weekend holiday begin?
dialogue.ur: Hafte ke aakhir mein aapki chhutti kab shuru hoti hai?

dialogue.ar: مَعَ مَنْ تَقْضي عُطْلَةَ الأُسْبوعِ، وَماذا تَفْعَلونَ؟
dialogue.tr: maʿa man taqḍī ʿuṭlata l-'usbūʿi, wamādhā tafʿalūna?
dialogue.en: With whom do you spend the weekend, and what do you do?
dialogue.ur: Aap hafte ki chhutti kis ke saath guzaarte hain aur kya karte hain?

dialogue.ar: بِماذا تُرَوِّحُ عَنْ نَفْسِكَ بَعْدَ يَوْمٍ طَويلٍ؟
dialogue.tr: bimādhā turawwiḥu ʿan nafsika baʿda yawmin ṭawaylin?
dialogue.en: How do you relax after a long day?
dialogue.ur: Lambe din ke baad aap kis cheez se dil behlate hain?

q.en: Which question asks how many hours you work?
q.ur: Kaun sa sawaal kaam ke ghanton ki tadaad poochta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ سُؤالٍ يَسْأَلُ عَنْ عَدَدِ ساعاتِ العَمَلِ؟

q.en: What does «الأُسْبوع» mean?
q.ur: «الأُسْبوع» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Which question asks about relaxing?
q.ur: Kaun sa sawaal dil behlane ke baare mein hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ سُؤالٍ يَسْأَلُ عَنْ طَريقَةِ الاسْتِراحَةِ؟

q.en: Which word means "day"?
q.ur: "Din" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى المُدَّةِ مِنْ شُروقِ الشَّمْسِ إِلى غُروبِها؟

intro.en: A reading text about why people need recreation and which kinds of recreation are useful. Think first: when did you last relax, and how?
intro.ur: Ek parhne ka matan: logon ko tafreeh ki zaroorat kyun hoti hai aur kaun si tafreeh mufeed hai. Pehle sochein: aapne akhri baar kab aur kaise aaram kiya?
intro.ar: نَصٌّ يُبَيِّنُ لِماذا يَحْتاجُ النّاسُ إِلَى التَّرْوِيحِ، وَما أَنْواعُهُ المُفيدَةُ. فَكِّرْ أَوَّلاً: مَتى رَوَّحْتَ عَنْ نَفْسِكَ آخِرَ مَرَّةٍ، وَكَيْفَ؟

dialogue.ar: لِكُلِّ إِنْسانٍ أَوْقاتٌ يَحْتاجُ فيها إِلَى الرّاحَةِ وَالمُتْعَةِ.
dialogue.tr: likulli insānin awqātun yaḥtāju fīhā ilā r-rāḥati wal-mutʿati.
dialogue.en: Every person has times when he needs rest and enjoyment.
dialogue.ur: Har insaan ke kuch aise waqt hote hain jin mein use aaram aur lutf ki zaroorat hoti hai.

dialogue.ar: فَالعامِلُ يَتْعَبُ مِنَ العَمَلِ، وَالطّالِبُ يَتْعَبُ مِنَ الدِّراسَةِ، وَكِلاهُما يَحْتاجُ إِلَى التَّرْوِيحِ.
dialogue.tr: fal-ʿāmilu yatʿabu mina l-ʿamali, waṭ-ṭālibu yatʿabu mina d-dirāsati, wakilāhumā yaḥtāju ilā t-tarwīḥi.
dialogue.en: The worker gets tired of work and the student gets tired of study, and both need recreation.
dialogue.ur: Mazdoor kaam se thakta hai aur talib-e-ilm parhai se, aur dono ko tafreeh ki zaroorat hai.

dialogue.ar: وَالأَنْشِطَةُ المُفيدَةُ تُريحُ العَقْلَ وَتُقَوّي الجِسْمَ.
dialogue.tr: wal-'anshiṭatu l-mufīdatu turīḥu l-ʿaqla watuqawway al-jisma.
dialogue.en: Useful activities rest the mind and strengthen the body.
dialogue.ur: Mufeed sargarmiyan dimaagh ko sukoon deti hain aur jism ko mazboot karti hain.

dialogue.ar: لَيْسَ الهَدَفُ أَنْ نَقْتُلَ الوَقْتَ بِلا فائِدَةٍ، بَلْ أَنْ نَسْتَعْمِلَهُ فيما يَنْفَعُنا.
dialogue.tr: laysa l-hadafu an naqtula l-waqta bilā fā'idatin, bal an nastaʿmilahu fīmā yanfaʿunā.
dialogue.en: The aim is not to kill time for nothing, but to use it for what benefits us.
dialogue.ur: Maqsad bekaar waqt zaaya karna nahi, balki use us kaam mein lagana hai jo hamare liye faidemand ho.

dialogue.ar: مِنْ أَنْواعِ التَّرْوِيحِ: القِراءَةُ في الحَديقَةِ، وَالمَشْيُ عَلَى الشّاطِئِ، وَالسَّفَرُ إِلى بِلادٍ جَديدَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: min anawʿi t-tarwīḥi: al-qirā'atu fī l-ḥadīqati, wal-mashyu ʿalā sh-shāṭi'i, was-safaru ilā bilādin jadīdatin.
dialogue.en: Kinds of recreation include reading in the garden, walking on the beach and travelling to new countries.
dialogue.ur: Tafreeh ki qismon mein hain: bagh mein parhna, saahil par sair karna aur naye mulkon ka safar.

dialogue.ar: وَيُحِبُّ بَعْضُ النّاسِ صَيْدَ السَّمَكِ، وَزِيارَةَ المَتاحِفِ، وَالإِقامَةَ في المُخَيَّماتِ.
dialogue.tr: wayuḥibbu baʿḍu n-nāsi ṣayda s-samaki, wazīrata l-matāḥifi, wal-'iqāmata fī l-mukhayyamāti.
dialogue.en: Some people like fishing, visiting museums and staying in camps.
dialogue.ur: Kuch log machhli ka shikar, ajaib ghar dekhna aur khaimon mein rehna pasand karte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَيُمارِسُ كَثيرٌ مِنَ الشَّبابِ الرِّياضَةَ، فَهِيَ تُعْطيهِمُ القُوَّةَ وَالنَّشاطَ.
dialogue.tr: wayumārisu kathīrun mina sh-shabābi r-rīḍata, fahiya tuʿṭīhimu l-quwwata wan-nashāṭa.
dialogue.en: Many young people do sport, because it gives them strength and energy.
dialogue.ur: Bohat se naujawan warzish karte hain kyunke woh unhein taaqat aur chusti deti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَلِلْقُوَّةِ مَكانَةٌ كَبيرَةٌ في الإِسْلامِ، وَالحَديثُ التّالي يُبَيِّنُ ذَلِكَ.
dialogue.tr: walilquwwati makānatun kabīratun fī l-'islāmi, wal-ḥadīthu t-tālī yubayyinu dhālika.
dialogue.en: Strength has a great place in Islam, and the following hadith shows that.
dialogue.ur: Islam mein taaqat ka bada maqam hai, aur agli hadees yeh batati hai.

dialogue.ar: قالَ الرَّسولُ ﷺ: (المُؤْمِنُ القَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللهِ مِنَ المُؤْمِنِ الضَّعيفِ، وَفي كُلٍّ خَيْر).
dialogue.tr: qāla r-rasūlu ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam: al-mu'minu l-qawiyyu khayrun wa aḥabbu ilā llāhi mina l-mu'mini ḍ-ḍaʿīf, wa fī kullin khayr
dialogue.en: The Messenger (peace be upon him) said: (The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, and in each there is good).
dialogue.ur: Rasoolullah ﷺ ne farmaya: (Taqatwar momin Allah ke nazdeek kamzor momin se behtar aur zyada pyara hai, aur har ek mein bhalai hai).

dialogue.ar: وَكانَ الصَّحابَةُ يَهْتَمّونَ بِتَدْريبِ أَبْنائِهِمْ عَلَى القُوَّةِ وَالمَهارَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wakāna ṣ-ṣaḥābatu yahtammūna bitadrībi abnā'ihim ʿalā l-quwwati wal-mahārati.
dialogue.en: The Companions cared about training their children in strength and skill.
dialogue.ur: Sahaba apne bachchon ko taaqat aur maharat sikhane ka khayal rakhte the.

dialogue.ar: وَيُرْوى عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الخَطّابِ قَوْلُهُ: عَلِّموا أَوْلادَكُمُ السِّباحَةَ وَالرِّمايَةَ وَرُكوبَ الخَيْل.
dialogue.tr: wayurawā ʿan ʿumara bni l-khaṭṭābi qawluhu: ʿallimū awlādakumu s-sibāḥata war-rimāyata warukūba l-khayl.
dialogue.en: It is reported from Umar ibn al-Khattab that he said: Teach your children swimming, archery and horse riding.
dialogue.ur: Umar bin Khattab se manqool hai ke unhon ne farmaya: apne bachchon ko tairaki, teer andazi aur ghurr-sawari sikhao.

dialogue.ar: فَلْنَخْتَرْ مِنَ التَّرْوِيحِ ما يَنْفَعُ أَجْسامَنا وَعُقولَنا.
dialogue.tr: falnakhtar mina t-tarwīḥi mā yanfaʿu ajsāmanā waʿuqūlanā.
dialogue.en: So let us choose the recreation that benefits our bodies and minds.
dialogue.ur: Aayiye hum woh tafreeh chunein jo hamare jismon aur dimaaghon ke liye faidemand ho.

q.en: Who needs recreation, according to the text?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq kise tafreeh ki zaroorat hai?
q.ar: مَنْ يَحْتاجُ إِلى التَّرْوِيحِ بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ؟

q.en: What is the aim of recreation?
q.ur: Tafreeh ka maqsad kya hai?

q.en: Recreation is useful for:
q.ur: Tafreeh kis ke liye faida mand hai?

q.en: What did ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb tell people to teach their children?
q.ur: Umar bin Khattab ne kya sikhane ko kaha?
q.ar: بِماذا أَوْصى عُمَرُ بْنُ الخَطّابِ أَنْ يُعَلِّمَ النّاسُ أَوْلادَهُمْ؟

q.en: What does «الشَّاطِئ» mean?
q.ur: «الشَّاطِئ» ka matlab kya hai?

options_ar: حَدُّ البَحْرِ حَيْثُ يَلْتَقي الماءُ بِالرَّمْلِ

intro.en: The fāʿil is the noun in the raised case (marfūʿ, with a damma ـُ) that did the action. Example: «يَقْرَأُ الطّالِبُ الدَّرْسَ» - «الطّالِبُ» did the action, so it is the fāʿil.
intro.ur: Fa'il woh ism marfoo' (damma wala) hai jisne kaam kiya. Misaal: «يَقْرَأُ الطّالِبُ الدَّرْسَ» - «الطّالِبُ» ne kaam kiya, isliye yeh fa'il hai.
intro.ar: الفاعِلُ اسْمٌ مَرْفوعٌ بِالضَّمَّةِ قامَ بِالفِعْلِ. مِثالٌ: «يَقْرَأُ الطّالِبُ الدَّرْسَ» - «الطّالِبُ» قامَ بِالقِراءَةِ، فَهُوَ الفاعِلُ.

dialogue.ar: الفاعِلُ اسْمٌ مَرْفوعٌ يَدُلُّ عَلى مَنْ قامَ بِالفِعْلِ.
dialogue.tr: al-fāʿilu smun marfūʿun yadullu ʿalā man qāma bil-fiʿli.
dialogue.en: The fāʿil is a raised noun that shows who did the action.
dialogue.ur: Fa'il woh marfoo' ism hai jo batata hai ke kaam kisne kiya.

dialogue.ar: يَقْرَأُ الطّالِبُ الدَّرْسَ.
dialogue.tr: yaqra'u ṭ-ṭālibu d-darsa.
dialogue.en: The student reads the lesson.
dialogue.ur: Talib-e-ilm sabaq parhta hai.

dialogue.ar: تَكْتُبُ المُعَلِّمَةُ عَلَى السَّبّورَةِ.
dialogue.tr: taktubu l-muʿallimatu ʿalā s-sabbūrati.
dialogue.en: The teacher writes on the board.
dialogue.ur: Ustaani takhte par likhti hain.

dialogue.ar: يَلْعَبُ الأَطْفالُ في الحَديقَةِ.
dialogue.tr: yalʿabu l-'aṭfālu fī l-ḥadīqati.
dialogue.en: The children play in the garden.
dialogue.ur: Bachche bagh mein khelte hain.

dialogue.ar: يَشْرَبُ الضَّيْفُ القَهْوَةَ.
dialogue.tr: yashrabu ḍ-ḍayfu l-qahwata.
dialogue.en: The guest drinks the coffee.
dialogue.ur: Mehmaan qehwa peeta hai.

dialogue.ar: يَنامُ الطِّفْلُ عَلَى السَّريرِ.
dialogue.tr: yanāmu ṭ-ṭiflu ʿalā s-sarīri.
dialogue.en: The child sleeps on the bed.
dialogue.ur: Bachcha bistar par sota hai.

dialogue.ar: يَلْبَسُ الوَلَدُ مَلابِسَ جَديدَةً.
dialogue.tr: yalbasu l-waladu malābisa jadīdatan.
dialogue.en: The boy wears new clothes.
dialogue.ur: Larka naye kapde pehenta hai.

dialogue.ar: يَطوفُ الحاجُّ بِالكَعْبَةِ المُشَرَّفَةِ.
dialogue.tr: yaṭūfu l-ḥājju bil-kaʿbati l-musharrafati.
dialogue.en: The pilgrim circles the honoured Kaaba.
dialogue.ur: Haji muazzam Kaaba ka tawaf karta hai.

vocab.en: the noun in the raised case

q.en: What is the fāʿil?
q.ur: Fa'il kya hai?

options: The raised noun that did the action

q.en: In «يَقْرَأُ الطّالِبُ الدَّرْسَ», who is the fāʿil?
q.ur: «يَقْرَأُ الطّالِبُ الدَّرْسَ» mein fa'il kaun hai?

q.en: In «يَطوفُ الحاجُّ بِالكَعْبَةِ المُشَرَّفَةِ», the fāʿil is:
q.ur: «يَطوفُ الحاجُّ بِالكَعْبَةِ المُشَرَّفَةِ» mein fa'il hai:
q.ar: في «يَطوفُ الحاجُّ بِالكَعْبَةِ المُشَرَّفَةِ» الفاعِلُ هُوَ:

q.en: Which ending shows the fāʿil is raised (marfūʿ)?
q.ur: Kaun si harkat fa'il ke marfoo' hone ki nishani hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ حَرَكَةٍ في آخِرِ الفاعِلِ تَدُلُّ عَلى أَنَّهُ مَرْفوعٌ؟

title.en: How do we spend the holiday?

intro.en: A family talks together about how to spend the holiday. Each child gives an idea. Notice the future with سَـ: «سَأَقْرَأُ» I will read, «سَأَسْبَحُ» I will swim.
intro.ur: Ek khandan milkar sochta hai ke chhuttiyan kaise guzaarein. Har bachcha apna khayal batata hai. Dhyan dein mustaqbil ke «سَـ» par: «سَأَقْرَأُ» main parhunga, «سَأَسْبَحُ» main tairunga.
intro.ar: تَتَحَدَّثُ أُسْرَةٌ عَنْ كَيْفِيَّةِ قَضاءِ العُطْلَةِ، وَيَذْكُرُ كُلُّ وَلَدٍ رَأْيَهُ. لاحِظِ المُسْتَقْبَلَ بِالسِّينِ: «سَأَقْرَأُ»، «سَأَسْبَحُ».

dialogue.ar: أَيّامُ العُطْلَةِ عَلَى الأَبْوابِ، فَماذا نَفْعَلُ يا أُمَّ يوسُفَ؟
dialogue.tr: ayymu l-ʿuṭlati ʿalā l-'abawbi, famādhā nafʿalu yā umma yawsufa?
dialogue.en: The holiday days are at the door, so what shall we do, Umm Yusuf?
dialogue.ur: Chhuttiyan darwaze par hain, to hum kya karein, Umm Yusuf?

dialogue.ar: عِنْدي فِكْرَةٌ: لِنَسْأَلِ الأَوْلادَ عَنْ آرائِهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: ʿindī fikratun: linas'ali l-'awlāda ʿan ārā'ihim.
dialogue.en: I have an idea: let us ask the children for their opinions.
dialogue.ur: Mere paas ek khayal hai: bachchon se unki raaye poochhte hain.

dialogue.ar: فِكْرَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ. نُناقِشُهُمْ جَميعاً حَوْلَ المائِدَةِ.
dialogue.tr: fikratun ḥasanatun. nunāqishuhum jamīʿan ḥawla l-mā'idati.
dialogue.en: A good idea. We will discuss it with all of them around the table.
dialogue.ur: Achha khayal hai. Hum sab ke saath dastarkhwan par baat karenge.

dialogue.ar: يا يوسُفُ، يا مَرْيَمُ، يا سَلْمانُ، يا رَنا، يا حَمْزَةُ، تَعالَوْا إِلَيْنا!
dialogue.tr: yā yawsufu, yā maryamu, yā salmānu, yā ranā, yā ḥamzatu, taʿālaw ilaynā!
dialogue.en: Yusuf, Maryam, Salman, Rana, Hamza, come to us!
dialogue.ur: Yusuf, Maryam, Salman, Rana, Hamza, humare paas aao!

dialogue.ar: هَيّا نَخْتَرْ مَعاً: أَيْنَ تُحِبّونَ أَنْ نَذْهَبَ؟ أَسْمِعونا آراءَكُمْ.
dialogue.tr: hayy nakhtar maʿan: ayna tuḥibbūna an nadhhaba? asmiʿūnā ārā'akum.
dialogue.en: Come, let us choose together: where would you like us to go? Let us hear your opinions.
dialogue.ur: Aayein milkar chunte hain: aap kahan jana pasand karenge? Apni raaye sunayein.

dialogue.ar: رَأْيي أَنْ نُسافِرَ إِلى مَصيفٍ بارِدٍ في الجِبالِ.
dialogue.tr: ra'ayay an nusāfira ilā maṣīfin bāridin fī l-jibāli.
dialogue.en: My opinion is that we travel to a cool summer resort in the mountains.
dialogue.ur: Meri raaye hai ke hum pahadon mein kisi thande tafreehi maqam par jayein.

dialogue.ar: رَأْيٌ جَميلٌ يا يوسُفُ. وَأَنْتِ يا مَرْيَمُ؟
dialogue.tr: ra'yun jamīlun yā yawsufu. wa'anti yā maryamu?
dialogue.en: A nice opinion, Yusuf. And you, Maryam?
dialogue.ur: Achhi raaye hai Yusuf. Aur aap, Maryam?

dialogue.ar: أُحِبُّ أَنْ نَزْرَعَ حَديقَةً صَغيرَةً أَمامَ البَيْتِ.
dialogue.tr: uḥibbu an nazraʿa ḥadīqatan ṣaghīratan amāma l-bayti.
dialogue.en: I would like us to plant a small garden in front of the house.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe pasand hai ke hum ghar ke saamne ek chhota sa bagh lagayein.

dialogue.ar: فِكْرَةٌ رائِعَةٌ! سَيَكونُ بَيْتُنا أَجْمَلَ بِالأَزْهارِ.
dialogue.tr: fikratun rā'iʿatun! sayakūnu baytunā ajmala bil-'azhāri.
dialogue.en: A wonderful idea! Our house will be more beautiful with flowers.
dialogue.ur: Bohat shandar khayal! Phoolon se hamara ghar aur khoobsurat ho jayega.

dialogue.ar: سَأَقْضي وَقْتاً أَمامَ التِّلْفازِ لِمُشاهَدَةِ البَرامِجِ العِلْمِيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: sa'aqḍī waqtan amāma t-tilfāzi limushāhadati l-barāmiji l-ʿilmiyyati.
dialogue.en: I will spend some time in front of the television watching science programmes.
dialogue.ur: Main television ke saamne ilmi programme dekhte hue waqt guzaarunga.

dialogue.ar: لا مانِعَ، بِشَرْطِ أَنْ تَكونَ البَرامِجُ مُفيدَةً وَالوَقْتُ قَصيراً.
dialogue.tr: lā māniʿa, bisharṭi an takūna l-barāmiju mufīdatan wal-waqtu qaṣīran.
dialogue.en: No objection, as long as the programmes are useful and the time is short.
dialogue.ur: Koi harj nahi, shart yeh hai ke programme mufeed hon aur waqt thoda ho.

dialogue.ar: وَأَنا سَأَقْرَأُ كُتُباً مُمْتِعَةً، وَأَحْكي لَكُمْ قِصَصَها.
dialogue.tr: wa'anā sa'aqra'u kutuban mumtiʿatan, wa'aḥkī lakum qiṣaṣahā.
dialogue.en: And I will read enjoyable books and tell you their stories.
dialogue.ur: Aur main dilchasp kitaabein parhungi aur aapko unki kahaniyan sunaungi.

dialogue.ar: وَأَنا سَأَسْبَحُ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ في المَسْبَحِ، وَسَأَلْعَبُ الكُرَةَ.
dialogue.tr: wa'anā sa'asbaḥu kulla yawmin fī l-masbaḥi, wasa'alʿabu l-kurata.
dialogue.en: And I will swim every day in the pool and I will play ball.
dialogue.ur: Aur main rozana tairaaki ke hauz mein tairunga aur gend khelunga.

dialogue.ar: رَأْيُكُمْ جَميعاً جَميلٌ، وَسَنَخْتارُ ما يُناسِبُنا.
dialogue.tr: ra'yukum jamīʿan jamīlun, wasanakhtāru mā yunāsibunā.
dialogue.en: All your opinions are nice, and we will choose what suits us.
dialogue.ur: Aap sab ki raaye achhi hai, aur hum woh chunenge jo hamare liye munasib ho.

dialogue.ar: نَرْجو لَكُمْ جَميعاً عُطْلَةً سَعيدَةً!
dialogue.tr: narjū lakum jamīʿan ʿuṭlatan saʿīdatan!
dialogue.en: We wish you all a happy holiday!
dialogue.ur: Hum aap sab ke liye khushgawar chhuttiyon ki dua karte hain!

q.en: What does Yusuf suggest for the holiday?
q.ur: Yusuf chhuttiyon ke liye kya tajweez karta hai?

q.en: Which child wants to plant a garden near the house?
q.ur: Kaun sa bachcha ghar ke paas bagh lagana chahta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ وَلَدٍ يُريدُ أَنْ يَزْرَعَ حَديقَةً قُرْبَ البَيْتِ؟

q.en: The mother allows the television only for:
q.ur: Ammi television ki ijazat sirf kis shart par deti hain?

q.en: Which letter shows the future in «سَأَقْرَأُ»?
q.ur: «سَأَقْرَأُ» mein mustaqbil ki nishani kaun si hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ حَرْفٍ يَدُلُّ عَلى المُسْتَقْبَلِ في «سَأَقْرَأُ»؟

q.en: Who will swim in the pool?
q.ur: Hauz mein kaun tairega?

intro.en: «يا» is a particle of calling. It comes before the person you call, who is called the munādā. Examples: «يا خالِدُ» O Khalid, «يا بَناتُ» O girls.
intro.ur: «يا» pukarne ka harf hai. Yeh us shakhs se pehle aata hai jise pukara jaye, use munada kehte hain. Misalein: «يا خالِدُ» ai Khalid, «يا بَناتُ» ai betiyo.
intro.ar: «يا» حَرْفُ نِداءٍ، يَأْتي قَبْلَ مَنْ نُنادِيهِ، وَيُسَمّى المُنادى. أَمْثِلَةٌ: «يا خالِدُ»، «يا بَناتُ».

dialogue.ar: حَرْفُ النِّداءِ «يا» نَضَعُهُ قَبْلَ الاسْمِ الَّذي نُريدُ أَنْ نُنادِيَهُ، وَيُسَمّى المُنادى.
dialogue.tr: ḥarfu n-nidā'i yā naḍaʿuhu qabla l-smi lladhī nurīdu an nunādiyahu, wayusammā l-munādā.
dialogue.en: The calling particle «يا» is placed before the name we want to call, and it is called the munādā.
dialogue.ur: Harf-e-nida «يا» us naam se pehle lagta hai jise hum pukarna chahte hain, use munada kehte hain.

dialogue.ar: يا خالِدُ، تَعالَ هُنا.
dialogue.tr: yā khālidu, taʿāla hunā.
dialogue.en: O Khalid, come here.
dialogue.ur: Ai Khalid, yahan aao.

dialogue.ar: يا بَناتُ، اِجْلِسْنَ.
dialogue.tr: yā banātu, ijlisna.
dialogue.en: O girls, sit down.
dialogue.ur: Ai betiyo, baith jao.

dialogue.ar: يا أُمَّ سَلْمى، شُكْراً لَكِ.
dialogue.tr: yā umma salmā, shukran laki.
dialogue.en: O Umm Salma, thank you.
dialogue.ur: Ai Umm Salma, aapka shukriya.

dialogue.ar: يا أَبا يوسُفَ، أَهْلاً بِكَ.
dialogue.tr: yā abā yawsufa, ahlan bika.
dialogue.en: O Abu Yusuf, welcome.
dialogue.ur: Ai Abu Yusuf, khush aamdeed.

dialogue.ar: يا أُخْتَ مَرْيَمَ، أَيْنَ كِتابُكِ؟
dialogue.tr: yā ukhta maryama, ayna kitābuki?
dialogue.en: O sister of Maryam, where is your book?
dialogue.ur: Ai Maryam ki behen, aapki kitaab kahan hai?

dialogue.ar: يا سائِقَ السَّيّارَةِ، لَوْ سَمَحْتَ تَوَقَّفْ عِنْدَ المَسْجِدِ.
dialogue.tr: yā sā'iqa s-sayyrati, law samaḥta tawaqqaf ʿinda l-masjidi.
dialogue.en: O driver of the car, please stop at the mosque.
dialogue.ur: Ai gaari ke driver, meherbani karke masjid par ruk jayein.

dialogue.ar: يَا أُخْتَ هَارُونَ.
dialogue.tr: yā ukhta Hārūn
dialogue.en: O sister of Harun. (Maryam 28)
dialogue.ur: Ai Harun ki behen. (Maryam 28)

dialogue.ar: يَا أَبَانَا اسْتَغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا.
dialogue.tr: yā abānā staghfir lanā dhunūbanā
dialogue.en: O our father, ask forgiveness for our sins for us. (Yusuf 97)
dialogue.ur: Ai hamare abba, hamare liye hamare gunahon ki maghfirat maangiye. (Yusuf 97)

dialogue.ar: يَا بُنَيَّ أَقِمِ الصَّلَاةَ.
dialogue.tr: yā bunayya aqimi ṣ-ṣalāh
dialogue.en: O my son, establish the prayer. (Luqman 17)
dialogue.ur: Ai mere bete, namaz qaim kar. (Luqman 17)

q.en: What is «يا» in «يا خالِدُ»?
q.ur: «يا خالِدُ» mein «يا» kya hai?

q.en: In «يا بَناتُ», who is the munādā (called)?
q.ur: «يا بَناتُ» mein munada (jise pukara gaya) kaun hai?

q.en: Which phrase uses «يا» correctly to call the driver?
q.ur: Driver ko pukarne ke liye kaun sa jumla sahi hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ عِبارَةٍ تَسْتَعْمِلُ «يا» اسْتِعْمالاً صَحيحاً لِنِداءِ السّائِقِ؟

q.en: What does «يا بُنَيَّ» mean?
q.ur: «يا بُنَيَّ» ka matlab kya hai?

options: O my son / Ai mere bete
O my father / Ai mere abba

title.en: Speaking: how do you spend the holiday?
title.ur: Bolna: aap chhutti kaise guzaarte hain?

intro.en: Pair activity: look at the pictures (a boy swimming, a girl reading, a man watching a film) and describe how each one spends the holiday. Then ask your friend the same question.
intro.ur: Jodi mein mashq: tasveerein dekhein (ek larka tair raha hai, ek larki parh rahi hai, ek aadmi film dekh raha hai) aur batayein ke har ek chhutti kaise guzaar raha hai. Phir apne dost se yahi sawal poochhein.
intro.ar: نَشاطٌ ثُنائِيٌّ: اُنْظُرْ إِلَى الصُّوَرِ (وَلَدٌ يَسْبَحُ، وَبِنْتٌ تَقْرَأُ، وَرَجُلٌ يُشاهِدُ فِيلْماً) وَصِفْ كَيْفَ يَقْضي كُلٌّ مِنْهُمُ العُطْلَةَ. ثُمَّ اسْأَلْ صَديقَكَ السُّؤالَ نَفْسَهُ.

dialogue.ar: ماذا يَفْعَلُ كُلُّ واحِدٍ في العُطْلَةِ؟
dialogue.tr: mādhā yafʿalu kullu wāḥidin fī l-ʿuṭlati?
dialogue.en: What does each one do in the holiday?
dialogue.ur: Har ek chhutti mein kya karta hai?

dialogue.ar: كَيْفَ تَقْضي أَنْتَ يَوْمَ العُطْلَةِ مَعَ صَديقِكَ؟
dialogue.tr: kayfa taqḍī anta yawma l-ʿuṭlati maʿa ṣadīqika?
dialogue.en: How do you spend the holiday with your friend?
dialogue.ur: Aap chhutti ka din apne dost ke saath kaise guzaarte hain?

dialogue.ar: هُوَ يَقْضي يَوْمَهُ في البَحْرِ، وَيَسْبَحُ كَثيراً.
dialogue.tr: huwa yaqḍī yawmahu fī l-baḥri, wayasbaḥu kathīran.
dialogue.en: He spends his day at the sea and swims a lot.
dialogue.ur: Woh apna din samundar par guzaarta hai aur bohat tairta hai.

dialogue.ar: هِيَ تَقْرَأُ قِصَّةً جَميلَةً في الحَديقَةِ.
dialogue.tr: hiya taqra'u qiṣṣatan jamīlatan fī l-ḥadīqati.
dialogue.en: She reads a beautiful story in the garden.
dialogue.ur: Woh bagh mein ek khoobsurat kahani parhti hai.

dialogue.ar: هُوَ يُشاهِدُ فِيلْماً عَنِ الحَيَواناتِ.
dialogue.tr: huwa yushāhidu fīlman ʿani l-ḥayawnāti.
dialogue.en: He watches a film about animals.
dialogue.ur: Woh janwaron ke baare mein film dekhta hai.

q.en: Which question asks a friend how they spend the holiday?
q.ur: Dost se chhutti guzaarne ka tareeqa kaun sa sawaal poochta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ سُؤالٍ يَسْأَلُ صَديقاً عَنْ كَيْفِيَّةِ قَضاءِ العُطْلَةِ؟

q.en: What does «يَسْبَحُ» mean?
q.ur: «يَسْبَحُ» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Which word means "friend"?
q.ur: "Dost" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تُطْلَقُ عَلى مَنْ تُحِبُّهُ وَتُصاحِبُهُ؟

q.en: Which sentence means "He watches television"?
q.ur: "Woh TV dekhta hai" kaun sa jumla hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ جُمْلَةٍ تَعْني أَنَّهُ يَنْظُرُ إِلى التِّلْفازِ؟

intro.en: A reading text about people who spend their free time in tents outside the city: where they go, how long they stay, and what they do there. Think first: where do people like to relax, at home or outdoors?
intro.ur: Un logon ke baare mein ek matan jo faarigh waqt shehar se bahar khaimon mein guzaarte hain: kahan jaate hain, kitni der rehte hain aur kya karte hain. Pehle sochein: log aaram kahan pasand karte hain, ghar mein ya bahar?
intro.ar: نَصٌّ عَنْ أُناسٍ يَقْضونَ أَوْقاتَ فَراغِهِمْ في الخِيامِ خارِجَ المَدينَةِ: أَيْنَ يَذْهَبونَ، وَكَمْ يَبْقَوْنَ، وَماذا يَفْعَلونَ. فَكِّرْ أَوَّلاً: أَيْنَ يُحِبُّ النّاسُ أَنْ يَسْتَريحوا، في البَيْتِ أَمْ في الهَواءِ الطَّلْقِ؟

dialogue.ar: يُحِبُّ كَثيرونَ أَنْ يَخْرُجوا مِنْ بُيوتِهِمْ إِلَى الطَّبيعَةِ، وَيَنْصِبوا الخِيامَ هُناكَ.
dialogue.tr: yuḥibbu kathīrūna an yakhrujū min buayawtihim ilā ṭ-ṭabīʿati, wayanṣibū l-khīma hunāka.
dialogue.en: Many people like to leave their houses for nature and pitch tents there.
dialogue.ur: Bohat se log apne gharon se nikal kar qudrat ki taraf jana aur wahan khaime lagana pasand karte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَهَذا ما نُسَمّيهِ التَّخْييمَ، وَالمَكانُ الَّذي يَنْزِلونَ فيهِ يُسَمّى المُخَيَّمَ.
dialogue.tr: wahādhā mā nusammīhi t-takhayayma, wal-makānu lladhī yanzilūna fīhi yusammā l-mukhayyama.
dialogue.en: This is what we call camping, and the place where they stay is called the camp.
dialogue.ur: Isi ko hum takhyeem (camping) kehte hain aur jahan woh theherte hain use mukhayyam kehte hain.

dialogue.ar: قَدْ يَبْقى المُخَيِّمونَ لَيْلَةً أَوْ لَيْلَتَيْنِ، وَقَدْ يَبْقَوْنَ عِدَّةَ أَسابيعَ.
dialogue.tr: qad yabqā l-mukhayyimūna laylatan aw laylatayni, waqad yabqawna ʿiddata asābīʿa.
dialogue.en: The campers may stay one night or two, and they may stay several weeks.
dialogue.ur: Khaima lagane wale ek do raat bhi rehte hain aur kai hafte bhi rehte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَيَخْتارونَ مَكاناً جَميلاً: عِنْدَ الجِبالِ، أَوْ في غابَةٍ خَضْراءَ، أَوْ قُرْبَ الصَّحْراءِ، حَيْثُ الهَواءُ النَّقِيُّ.
dialogue.tr: wayakhtārūna makānan jamīlan: ʿinda l-jibāli, aw fī ghābatin khaḍrā'a, aw qurba ṣ-ṣaḥrā'i, ḥaythu l-haw'u n-naqiyyu.
dialogue.en: They choose a beautiful place: near the mountains, or in a green forest, or near the desert, where the air is pure.
dialogue.ur: Woh khoobsurat jagah chunte hain: pahadon ke paas, hare bhare jungle mein ya registan ke qareeb, jahan hawa saaf hoti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَقَبْلَ السَّفَرِ يُجَهِّزُ النّاسُ المَلابِسَ وَالطَّعامَ وَالشَّرابَ، وَيَحْمِلونَ الماءَ مَعَهُمْ.
dialogue.tr: waqabla s-safari yujahhizu n-nāsu l-malābisa waṭ-ṭaʿāma wash-sharāba, wayaḥmilūna l-mā'a maʿahum.
dialogue.en: Before the trip people prepare clothes, food and drink, and they carry water with them.
dialogue.ur: Safar se pehle log kapde, khana aur peene ki cheezein tayyar karte hain aur apne saath paani le jaate hain.

dialogue.ar: وَفي الصَّباحِ يَمْشونَ بَيْنَ الأَشْجارِ، وَيُصَوِّرونَ الطُّيورَ وَالمَناظِرَ الجَميلَةَ.
dialogue.tr: wafī ṣ-ṣabāḥi yamshūna bayna l-'ashjāri, wayuṣawwirūna ṭ-ṭuayawra wal-manāẓira l-jamīlata.
dialogue.en: In the morning they walk among the trees and photograph the birds and the beautiful views.
dialogue.ur: Subah ko woh darakhton ke beech chalte hain aur parindon aur khoobsurat manazir ki tasveerein khenchte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَفي المَساءِ يَجْلِسونَ حَوْلَ النّارِ، وَيُعِدّونَ الطَّعامَ، وَيَتَحَدَّثونَ.
dialogue.tr: wafī l-masā'i yajlisūna ḥawla n-nāri, wayuʿiddūna ṭ-ṭaʿāma, wayataḥaddathūna.
dialogue.en: In the evening they sit around the fire, prepare food and talk.
dialogue.ur: Shaam ko woh aag ke gird baithte hain, khana banate hain aur baatein karte hain.

dialogue.ar: أَمّا الأَطْفالُ فَيَفْرَحونَ بِالخَيْمَةِ، وَيَسْتَمِعونَ إِلى قِصَصِ الكِبارِ.
dialogue.tr: ammā l-'aṭfālu fayafraḥūna bil-khaymati, wayastamiʿūna ilā qiṣaṣi l-kibāri.
dialogue.en: As for the children, they are happy with the tent and listen to the grown-ups' stories.
dialogue.ur: Rahe bachche, woh khaime se khush hote hain aur bado ki kahaniyan sunte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَبَعْدَ العَوْدَةِ يَشْعُرُ الجَميعُ بِالرّاحَةِ وَالنَّشاطِ.
dialogue.tr: wabaʿda l-ʿawdati yashʿuru l-jamīʿu bir-rāḥati wan-nashāṭi.
dialogue.en: After returning, everyone feels rested and energetic.
dialogue.ur: Wapas aane ke baad sab log aaram aur chusti mehsoos karte hain.

q.en: Where do many people prefer recreation, according to the text?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq bohat se log tafreeh kahan pasand karte hain?
q.ar: أَيْنَ يُفَضِّلُ كَثيرٌ مِنَ النّاسِ التَّرْوِيحَ بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ؟

q.en: How long may people stay in camps?
q.ur: Log khaimon mein kitni der reh sakte hain?

q.en: What do campers do in the morning, according to the text?
q.ur: Matan ke mutabiq khaima lagane wale subah ko kya karte hain?
q.ar: ماذا يَفْعَلُ المُخَيِّمونَ في الصَّباحِ بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ؟

q.en: What does «الصَّحْراء» mean?
q.ur: «الصَّحْراء» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Which word means "tents"?
q.ur: "Khaime" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تُطْلَقُ عَلى بُيوتِ القُماشِ الَّتي يَسْكُنُها المُخَيِّمونَ؟

intro.en: «لا» before a present verb means "do not". It is one of the words of prohibition. Example: «لا تُكْثِرْ مِنَ السُّكَّرِ» - Do not overdo sugar. Notice the verb ends with a sukun ـْ.
intro.ur: «لا» fe'l-e-mudari se pehle aaye to matlab hota hai "mat karo". Yeh nahi (mana karne) ke alfaaz mein se hai. Misaal: «لا تُكْثِرْ مِنَ السُّكَّرِ» - cheeni zyada mat lo. Dhyan dein fe'l sukoon par khatam hota hai.
intro.ar: «لا» قَبْلَ الفِعْلِ المُضارِعِ تُفيدُ النَّهْيَ. مِثالٌ: «لا تُكْثِرْ مِنَ السُّكَّرِ». لاحِظْ أَنَّ الفِعْلَ يَنْتَهي بِالسُّكونِ ـْ.

dialogue.ar: «لا» النّاهِيَةُ تَدْخُلُ عَلَى الفِعْلِ المُضارِعِ فَتَدُلُّ عَلَى النَّهْيِ، وَيَنْتَهي الفِعْلُ بَعْدَها بِالسُّكونِ.
dialogue.tr: lā n-nāhiyatu tadkhulu ʿalā l-fiʿli l-muḍāriʿi fatadullu ʿalā n-nahyi, wayantahī l-fiʿlu baʿdahā bis-sukūni.
dialogue.en: The prohibiting «لا» enters the present verb and shows prohibition, and the verb after it ends with a sukun.
dialogue.ur: «لا» nahiya fe'l-e-mudari par aata hai, mana karne ka matlab deta hai aur uske baad fe'l sukoon par khatam hota hai.

dialogue.ar: لا تَبْتَعِدْ عَنْ أُمِّكَ في السّوقِ.
dialogue.tr: lā tabtaʿid ʿan ummika fī s-sūqi.
dialogue.en: Do not go away from your mother in the market.
dialogue.ur: Bazaar mein apni ammi se door mat jana.

dialogue.ar: لا تُكْثِرْ مِنَ السُّكَّرِ، فَهُوَ يُتْعِبُ الجِسْمَ.
dialogue.tr: lā tukthir mina s-sukkari, fahuwa yutʿibu l-jisma.
dialogue.en: Do not overdo sugar, for it tires the body.
dialogue.ur: Cheeni zyada mat lo, yeh jism ko thakata hai.

dialogue.ar: لا تَأْكُلِ اللُّحومَ الدَّسِمَةَ كَثيراً.
dialogue.tr: lā ta'kuli l-luḥūma d-dasimata kathīran.
dialogue.en: Do not eat fatty meats a lot.
dialogue.ur: Chikna gosht zyada mat khao.

dialogue.ar: لا تَشْرَبِ القَهْوَةَ في اللَّيْلِ.
dialogue.tr: lā tashrabi l-qahwata fī l-layli.
dialogue.en: Do not drink coffee at night.
dialogue.ur: Raat ko qehwa mat piyo.

dialogue.ar: لا تَضَعِ المِلْحَ الكَثيرَ عَلَى الأُرُزِّ.
dialogue.tr: lā taḍaʿi l-milḥa l-kathīra ʿalā l-'uruzzi.
dialogue.en: Do not put a lot of salt on the rice.
dialogue.ur: Chawal par bohat namak mat daalo.

dialogue.ar: لا تُعْطِ الطِّفْلَ حَليباً ساخِناً جِدّاً.
dialogue.tr: lā tuʿṭi ṭ-ṭifla ḥalīban sākhinan jiddan.
dialogue.en: Do not give the child very hot milk.
dialogue.ur: Bachche ko bohat garam doodh mat do.

dialogue.ar: لا تَنْسَ أَنْ تَتَناوَلَ دَواءَكَ.
dialogue.tr: lā tansa an tatanāwala daw'aka.
dialogue.en: Do not forget to take your medicine.
dialogue.ur: Apni dawa lena mat bhoolna.

q.en: What does «لا تَأْكُلْ» mean?
q.ur: «لا تَأْكُلْ» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: How do you say "Do not drink coffee"?
q.ur: "Coffee mat piyo" kaise kahenge?
q.ar: كَيْفَ تَقولُ: نَهْيٌ عَنْ شُرْبِ القَهْوَةِ؟

q.en: Which word means "salt"?
q.ur: "Namak" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تُضافُ إِلى الطَّعامِ فَتُعْطيهِ طَعْماً مالِحاً؟

q.en: What does the verb after prohibiting «لا» end with?
q.ur: «لا» ke baad fe'l ke aakhir mein kya aata hai?

q.en: «لا تَشْرَبِ القَهْوَةَ في اللَّيْلِ» means:
q.ur: «لا تَشْرَبِ القَهْوَةَ في اللَّيْلِ» ka matlab:
q.ar: ما معنى «لا تَشْرَبِ القَهْوَةَ في اللَّيْلِ»؟

options: Do not drink coffee at night

intro.en: Describe places in three sentences (forest, desert, beach), put words in order to make sentences, and learn punctuation marks: the semicolon, the colon, quotation marks and the dash.
intro.ur: Teen jumlon mein jagahon ka bayan karein (jungle, registan, sahil), alfaaz ko tarteeb de kar jumle banayein, aur alamaat-e-tarqeem seekhein: nuqta-o-kama, do nuqte, iqtibaas ke nishan aur dash.
intro.ar: صِفْ أَماكِنَ في ثَلاثِ جُمَلٍ (غابَةٌ، صَحْراءُ، شاطِئٌ)، وَرَتِّبِ الكَلِماتِ لِتَصْنَعَ جُمَلاً، وَتَعَلَّمْ عَلاماتِ التَّرْقيمِ: الفاصِلَةَ المَنْقوطَةَ، وَالنُّقْطَتَيْنِ، وَعَلامَتَيِ التَّنْصيصِ، وَالشَّرْطَةَ.

dialogue.ar: يَجِبُ أَنْ يَحْتَرِمَ الطّالِبُ مُعَلِّمَهُ.
dialogue.tr: yajibu an yaḥtarima ṭ-ṭālibu muʿallimahu.
dialogue.en: The student must respect his teacher.
dialogue.ur: Talib-e-ilm ko chahiye ke apne ustaad ka ehtiram kare.

dialogue.ar: مِنَ الجَميلِ مُساعَدَةُ الجيرانِ في أَوْقاتِ الشِّدَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: mina l-jamīli musāʿadatu l-jīrāni fī awqāti sh-shiddati.
dialogue.en: It is lovely to help the neighbours in hard times.
dialogue.ur: Mushkil waqt mein parosiyon ki madad karna achhi baat hai.

dialogue.ar: تُعْجِبُني زِيارَةُ مَدينَةٍ بَعيدَةٍ في الصَّيْفِ.
dialogue.tr: tuʿjibunī zīratu madīnatin baʿīdatin fī ṣ-ṣayfi.
dialogue.en: I like visiting a far-away city in the summer.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe garmiyon mein kisi door ke shehar ki sair pasand hai.

dialogue.ar: يَحْتاجُ المُعَلِّمُ إِلى إِجازَةٍ قَصيرَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: yaḥtāju l-muʿallimu ilā ijāzatin qaṣīratin.
dialogue.en: The teacher needs a short leave.
dialogue.ur: Ustaad ko ek mukhtasar chhutti ki zaroorat hai.

dialogue.ar: لا يُحِبُّ الصِّغارُ الجُلوسَ طَويلاً أَمامَ الشّاشَةِ.
dialogue.tr: lā yuḥibbu ṣ-ṣighāru l-julūsa ṭawaylan amāma sh-shāshati.
dialogue.en: Little ones do not like sitting long in front of the screen.
dialogue.ur: Chhote bachche screen ke saamne der tak baithna pasand nahi karte.

dialogue.ar: كانَ أَبو بَكْرٍ - رَضِيَ اللهُ عَنْهُ - صاحِبَ الرَّسولِ ﷺ في الهِجْرَةِ.
dialogue.tr: kāna abū bakrin - raḍiya llāh ʿanhu - ṣāḥiba r-rasūli ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam fī l-hijrati.
dialogue.en: Abu Bakr - may Allah be pleased with him - was the Prophet's ﷺ companion in the Hijra.
dialogue.ur: Abu Bakr - Allah un se raazi ho - hijrat mein Rasool ﷺ ke saathi the.

dialogue.ar: قالَتِ المُعَلِّمَةُ: «اُكْتُبوا الدَّرْسَ بِخَطٍّ جَميلٍ».
dialogue.tr: qālati l-muʿallimatu: uktubū d-darsa bikhaṭṭin jamīlin.
dialogue.en: The teacher said: "Write the lesson in a beautiful hand."
dialogue.ur: Ustaani ne kaha: "Sabaq khoobsurat khat mein likho."

dialogue.ar: سافَرْنا إِلَى المَدينَةِ المُنَوَّرَةِ؛ لِنَزورَ المَسْجِدَ النَّبَوِيَّ.
dialogue.tr: sāfarnā ilā l-madīnati l-munawwarati; linazūra l-masjida n-nabawiyya.
dialogue.en: We travelled to Madinah; to visit the Prophet's Mosque.
dialogue.ur: Hum Madina Munawwara gaye; taake Masjid-e-Nabawi ki ziyarat karein.

title.en: Handwriting and spelling: the closed tā' (ة)

intro.en: The closed tā' (ـة / ة) looks like the pronoun hā' (ـه / ه) and both are pronounced as «h» when you stop. Example: «قَرْيَة» (village) ends in tā' marbūṭa; «أَبوهُ» (his father) ends in hā'. Copy the verse «إِنَّمَا المُؤْمِنونَ إِخْوَة فَأَصْلِحوا بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُم».
intro.ur: Taa marboota (ـة / ة) zameer ke haa (ـه / ه) jaisi lagti hai aur ruk kar dono ki awaaz «h» jaisi aati hai. Misaal: «قَرْيَة» (gaon) taa marboota par khatam hota hai; «أَبوهُ» (uske walid) haa par. Aayat likhne ki mashq karein: «إِنَّمَا المُؤْمِنونَ إِخْوَة فَأَصْلِحوا بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُم».
intro.ar: التّاءُ المَرْبوطَةُ (ـة / ة) تُشْبِهُ هاءَ الضَّميرِ (ـه / ه)، وَتُنْطَقانِ هاءً عِنْدَ الوَقْفِ. مِثالٌ: «قَرْيَة» تَنْتَهي بِتاءٍ مَرْبوطَةٍ، وَ«أَبوهُ» تَنْتَهي بِهاءِ الضَّميرِ. اِنْسَخِ الآيَةَ «إِنَّمَا المُؤْمِنونَ إِخْوَة فَأَصْلِحوا بَيْنَ أَخَوَيْكُم».

intro.en: A review of Units 1 and 2. It starts with a reading about Najla, a student who also works, and then has questions about grammar and vocabulary: correct or incorrect sentences, mistakes, word meanings and question words.
intro.ur: Unit 1 aur 2 ki dohrai. Pehle Najla ke baare mein ek matan hai, jo talibah bhi hai aur kaam bhi karti hai, phir qawaid aur alfaaz ke sawal hain: durust ya ghalat jumle, ghaltiyan, alfaaz ke maani aur sawali alfaaz.
intro.ar: مُراجَعَةٌ لِلْوَحْدَتَيْنِ الأُولى وَالثّانِيَةِ. تَبْدَأُ بِنَصٍّ عَنْ نَجْلاءَ، وَهِيَ طالِبَةٌ تَعْمَلُ أَيْضاً، ثُمَّ أَسْئِلَةٌ في القَواعِدِ وَالمُفْرَداتِ: جُمَلٌ صَحيحَةٌ وَخاطِئَةٌ، وَأَخْطاءٌ، وَمَعاني كَلِماتٍ، وَأَدَواتُ اسْتِفْهامٍ.

dialogue.ar: نَجْلاءُ طالِبَةٌ في الجامِعَةِ، وَتَعْمَلُ بَعْدَ الظُّهْرِ في مَصْنَعٍ لِلْحَلْوَى.
dialogue.tr: najlā'u ṭālibatun fī l-jāmiʿati, wataʿmalu baʿda ẓ-ẓuhri fī maṣnaʿin lilḥalwā.
dialogue.en: Najla is a university student, and she works after noon in a sweets factory.
dialogue.ur: Najla jamia ki talibah hai aur zohar ke baad mithai ke karkhane mein kaam karti hai.

dialogue.ar: تَرْكَبُ القِطارَ كُلَّ صَباحٍ لِتَصِلَ إِلَى الكُلِّيَّةِ.
dialogue.tr: tarkabu l-qiṭāra kulla ṣabāḥin litaṣila ilā l-kulliyyati.
dialogue.en: Every morning she takes the train to reach the college.
dialogue.ur: Har subah woh college pohanchne ke liye train mein sawar hoti hai.

dialogue.ar: تَبْدَأُ المُحاضَراتُ السّاعَةَ التّاسِعَةَ صَباحاً، وَتَنْتَهي في الواحِدَةِ.
dialogue.tr: tabda'u l-muḥāḍarātu s-sāʿata t-tāsiʿata ṣabāḥan, watantahī fī l-awḥidati.
dialogue.en: Lectures begin at nine in the morning and end at one.
dialogue.ur: Lectures subah nau baje shuru hote hain aur ek baje khatam hote hain.

dialogue.ar: تَتَناوَلُ نَجْلاءُ الغَداءَ في مَطْعَمٍ صَغيرٍ قُرْبَ الجامِعَةِ.
dialogue.tr: tatanāwalu najlā'u l-ghadā'a fī maṭʿamin ṣaghīrin qurba l-jāmiʿati.
dialogue.en: Najla has lunch in a small restaurant near the university.
dialogue.ur: Najla jamia ke qareeb ek chhote restaurant mein dopahar ka khana khaati hai.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ تَرْكَبُ الحافِلَةَ إِلَى المَصْنَعِ، وَيَبْدَأُ عَمَلُها السّاعَةَ الثّالِثَةَ بَعْدَ الظُّهْرِ وَيَنْتَهي السّاعَةَ السّابِعَةَ مَساءً.
dialogue.tr: thumma tarkabu l-ḥāfilata ilā l-maṣnaʿi, wayabda'u ʿamaluhā s-sāʿata th-thālithata baʿda ẓ-ẓuhri wayantahī s-sāʿata s-sābiʿata masā'an.
dialogue.en: Then she takes the bus to the factory; her work begins at three after noon and ends at seven in the evening.
dialogue.ur: Phir woh bus se karkhane jaati hai; uska kaam teen baje shuru hota hai aur saat baje shaam ko khatam hota hai.

dialogue.ar: حَدَثَ في الأُسْبوعِ الماضي أَنْ أُغْمِيَ عَلَى نَجْلاءَ أَثْناءَ عَمَلِها، فَنَقَلَتْها زَميلاتُها إِلَى المُسْتَشْفى، وَحينَ أَفاقَتْ وَجَدَتْ نَفْسَها في غُرْفَةٍ بَيْضاءَ وَأُمَّها بِجانِبِها.
dialogue.tr: ḥadatha fī l-'usbūʿi l-māḍī an ughmiya ʿalā najlā'a athnā'a ʿamalihā, fanaqalathā zamīlātuhā ilā l-mustashfā, waḥīna afāqat wajadat nafsahā fī ghurfatin bayḍā'a wa'ummahā bijānibihā.
dialogue.en: It happened last week that Najla fainted during her work, her colleagues took her to the hospital, and when she woke up she found herself in a white room with her mother beside her.
dialogue.ur: Pichhle hafte yeh hua ke kaam ke dauran Najla behosh ho gayi, uski saheliyan use hospital le gayin aur hosh aane par usne khud ko ek safed kamre mein paaya aur ammi paas thin.

dialogue.ar: وَجاءَ والِدُها أَيْضاً، وَقَرَأَ الطَّبيبُ التَّقْريرَ الطِّبِّيَّ.
dialogue.tr: wajā'a wāliduhā ayḍan, waqara'a ṭ-ṭabību t-taqrīra ṭ-ṭibbiyya.
dialogue.en: Her father came too, and the doctor read the medical report.
dialogue.ur: Uske walid bhi aaye aur doctor ne tibbi report parhi.

dialogue.ar: قالَ لِلْوالِدَيْنِ: نَجْلاءُ بِخَيْرٍ، وَالحَمْدُ للهِ، لَكِنَّها مُتْعَبَةٌ، فَهِيَ تَدْرُسُ وَتَعْمَلُ. لابُدَّ لَها مِنْ راحَةٍ، وَمِنْ طَعامٍ جَيِّدٍ.
dialogue.tr: qāla lilawlidayni: najlā'u bikhayrin, wal-ḥamdu llhi, lakinnahā mutʿabatun, fahiya tadrusu wataʿmalu. lābudda lahā min rāḥatin, wamin ṭaʿāmin jayyidin.
dialogue.en: He said to the parents: Najla is fine, praise be to Allah, but she is tired, for she studies and works. She must have rest and good food.
dialogue.ur: Usne walidain se kaha: Najla theek hai, alhamdulillah, lekin thaki hui hai kyunke woh parhti bhi hai aur kaam bhi karti hai. Use aaram aur achhe khane ki zaroorat hai.
